note: What a server sends to change how a unit's resource bar is shown. The header names the unit.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: Unused; its bytes carry no meaning. The header names the unit.

fields.name: state
fields.note: Which way the resource is shown; a client sets the unit's resource bar by it, and what each value looks like depends on the unit's own data.
